To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the main predictors of participation in climate protests were moral motivation and identification with the environmental movement, and that the most salient framing tasks were the interlinkage of global and local dimensions, and the arguments of urgency and severity.
the key factors for explaining actual protest are the moral motivation to act and identification as an activist.

the key predictors of protest behavior in the Portuguese climate protests were identification as an environmental activist and moral motivation, whereas the key framing tasks were the interlinkage of global and local dimensions, severity and urgency, and a focus on the future.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what motivates people to participate in social movement actions.
the question of why people protest, what they protest about, and how they protest.
the study of the reasons that explain the actual protest behavior of demonstrators and the core frames that are used to mobilize them.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Portuguese climate movement is a movement that mobilizes people to protest for the sake of the environment and the future generations, and not necessarily because of the immediate consequences of the problem to themselves.
the climate movement is a movement that is driven by moral motivation, identification as an environmentalists and the framing of severity and urgency.

the results of this research suggest that people are more likely to engage in collective action for climate change related issues when they are motivated by moral concerns, when they identify as environmentalists, when they have a strong sense of collective action efficacy and when they have strong beliefs in the effectiveness of protest as a means to bring change.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more people feel that climate change is a moral problem, the more likely they are to protest.
the more people are concerned with the environment the more they are motivated to protest.

moral motivation, environmental identification and the framing of climate change as a global problem with local consequences, are key variables in explaining the mobilization of people for climate change related protests.
The main takeaway from our work is that
moral motivations and identification as an activist are the main drivers of actual protest.
moral motivation and identity as an environmentalist are key factors to explain the willingness to engage in collective action.
the climate movement in Portugal is not only concerned with the global dimensions of climate change.
